title: Signal: Conan requirement without a recipe revision
scope: A conanfile.txt file that declares a requirement pinned to a version but no revision.
limitations: It matches a requirement pinned to a version but no revision in the parsed conanfile.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A conanfile.txt that mentions a requirement pinned to a version but no revision in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
